Before you start

How to submit your work.

  1. 01

    Do the work

    Complete each assignment, activity and test, and save each one as its own file.

  2. 02

    Record your answers

    Record yourself answering each question on video, with a separate recording for each question.

  3. 03

    Upload and paste

    Upload everything to your Google Drive, set each file to "Anyone with the link can view", and paste each link into its space below.

Protect your information. Don't include ID numbers, financial details or other sensitive information in your recordings or files. If you need an accommodation to complete this assessment, email contact@seudocom.org.
